description: Local MusicGen-small generation for prototyping. Non-commercial model licence: outputs are blocked from shipping until licence review.
notes: CC-BY-NC 4.0 model: prototype only, not for commercial shipping without licence review.

Installed 2026-10-25 in a Python 3.10 venv (torch 2.11.0+cu128, transformers 5.20.2). Measured: 6 s clip at 32 kHz in 35.5 s on the T600; float16 produced NaNs and the generator detected the silence and retried float32.
